objective: Remove the committed RENDER_WORKER_SECRET fallback and make the distributed render-worker dispatch path fail closed, so a broken claim, a failed downstream dispatch or a lost callback can no longer be reported as an empty queue or a successful delivery.

rulesConsidered: .okf/security/worker-permissions.md §13 — any side-effecting distributed worker operation must respect an active lease, fencing token, current attempt identity and callback authentication; expired or stale workers cannot successfully commit.
.okf/security/worker-permissions.md §22.8 — no physical success claims without verification.
.okf/security/worker-permissions.md §22.9 — no secrets in worker working memory unless explicitly required and sandboxed.
.okf/security/worker-permissions.md §9 — CAP_RENDER_DISPATCH records job identity and waits for the authoritative callback; it does not mark a job complete.
.okf/audits/final-system-acceptance-matrix.md — "Workflows fail-closed ..., no `|| true` masking fatal errors" was recorded as VERIFIED, which the dispatcher did not satisfy.
.okf/decision-protocol.md — classify before implementing; executable implementation and tests outrank .okf when they conflict.

notes: A credential committed to public source history ('factoryos-render-worker-secret-key-2026') was removed from both workflows and must be treated as compromised. OPERATOR ACTION: rotate RENDER_WORKER_SECRET on the control plane and in repository secrets.
No secret value or execution token is written to any log sink; the execution token is masked in the dispatch step and is only published via GITHUB_OUTPUT.
Failed authentication, HTTP errors, timeouts and malformed responses now fail the workflow instead of producing claimed=false.
Authentication was not weakened and no default, dummy or fallback credential was introduced. No new API endpoint was invented.
The dispatcher job's actions:write permission is deliberately not granted; granting it is an owner decision and is out of scope for this change.

Separate operator action: a personal access token was exposed in plaintext in an unrelated terminal log. Its owner must revoke it. No token value is recorded in this report and it was neither used nor tested.

conflicts.originalConflict: .okf/audits/final-system-acceptance-matrix.md records the CI/CD requirement 'Workflows fail-closed on build, lint, typecheck, or render failures; no `|| true` masking fatal errors' as VERIFIED, while .github/workflows/factoryos-render-worker.yml suppressed a failed `gh workflow run` with `|| echo` and converted every claim exception into claimed=false.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Reconcile the implementation with the already-canonical rule: remove the suppressed failure and the blanket exception handling, and fail visibly on every non-empty-queue outcome. The rule is unchanged; the implementation now satisfies it.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Dispatcher failures and callback failures now fail the workflow. Empty queue remains the only non-failure outcome.

conflicts.originalConflict: The dispatcher's repository_dispatch path read DISPATCH_JOB_ID and implied it could act on a specific job, but POST /api/rendering/claim accepts only workerId and workerPool and cannot target a named job.
conflicts.proposedResolution: The dispatcher no longer implies authority it does not have: a dispatch that names a job is refused (exit code 3) instead of being silently satisfied by an unrelated queued job, and the required control-plane change is documented in docs/deployment/render-worker-secrets.md §7. No endpoint or request parameter was invented.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Named-job dispatch is refused; the absence of a job-targeted claim capability is tracked as a remaining blocker and is not implemented speculatively in this change.

changes: .github/workflows/factoryos-render-worker.yml: removed the committed secret fallback, wired DISPATCH_JOB_ID to github.event.client_payload.jobId, delegated the claim to a tested script, removed the `|| echo` dispatch suppression, and masked the execution token.
.github/workflows/factoryos-basic-render.yml: removed the committed secret fallback, added a fail-closed preflight before the callback, and made a failed callback fail the run.

services/rendering-engine/scripts/github_dispatch_claim.py (new): single claim client with exit codes 0 (resolved), 2 (missing configuration, no request made), 3 (named-job dispatch refused), 4 (claim not established).
services/rendering-engine/tests/test_github_dispatch_claim.py (new): 16 behavioural cases over a mocked transport.
apps/web/factoryos/tests/render-worker-fail-closed.test.ts (new): 18 static invariant checks over both workflows and the claim client.
docs/deployment/render-worker-secrets.md (new): configuration, rotation procedure, fail-closed behaviour table, dispatch-permission limitation, and the backend change needed.
.okf/decisions.md: decision record for this change, now including the measured worker-daemon syntax repair and why the removed Azure-only ADMIN guard is deliberately not restored.

services/rendering-engine/worker_daemon.py: removed an orphaned indented return and the now-unused tier assignment left behind when commit 1ce28a3aa1dbc259617c50cbb18b2eb349d73a97 removed the Azure-only non-ADMIN guard during the provider-neutral refactor. The old Azure-only restriction was not restored.
services/rendering-engine/tests/test_worker_daemon_syntax.py: add an AST-parse regression test so the persistent worker daemon cannot silently regress to an import-blocking syntax error.

verificationResults.fullFactoryosSuiteDetail: Final head 3ad2705a: 67 files failed | 242 passed | 3 skipped (312); 71 tests failed | 1447 passed | 9 skipped (1527). Pristine main ed966487 on the same machine: 67 failed | 241 passed | 3 skipped (311); 71 failed | 1429 passed | 9 skipped (1509). Five files fail on the head only and five on main only; those ten were re-run in isolation and interleaved A/B on both trees, and both commits fail them under this machine's ambient load (29 node processes, including the operator's own dev servers), so they are load-dependent rather than regressions. verificationResults.workerDaemonSyntaxDetail: Final head 3ad2705a. `python -m py_compile worker_daemon.py` exits 0; an AST parse of the file succeeds (664 lines); `pytest tests/test_worker_daemon_syntax.py` reports 1 passed. Pristine main ed966487 fails `py_compile` at line 549 with IndentationError, so this is the exact repair and not a cosmetic change.
verificationResults.workerDaemonPySuiteDetail: Final head: `python -m pytest tests -q` collects 52 tests with 0 collection errors and reports 50 passed, 2 failed. Per module on the head: test_worker_daemon_syntax 1/1, test_drive_delivery 7/7, test_basic_recovery 13/13, test_basic_render_worker 4/4, test_github_dispatch_claim 16/16, test_basic_render_api 8 passed/1 failed. Both failures are pre-existing and reproduce identically on pristine main: test_basic_render_api.py::test_health_endpoint asserts 'factoryos-basic-render' while basic_render_api.py:86 reports 'factoryos-persistent-render' (that file is not touched by this PR), and test_quiz_renderer_parity.py::test_canonical_quiz_render_end_to_end requires live edge-tts and receives HTTP 403 from the Microsoft speech endpoint on both trees. On pristine main the suite cannot run at all: collection aborts with the worker_daemon.py IndentationError after 28 of 52 tests, and tests/test_drive_delivery.py (7 tests, including test_no_default_secret_string_in_codebase, the guard that detects the compromised secret literal) is uncollectable.
verificationResults.liveRenderExecutionDetail: No credentials or runtime available in this environment. No physical MP4, CAS receipt or F07 proof is claimed.
verificationResults.liveClaimAgainstControlPlaneDetail: The claim client is exercised only against a mocked transport in test_github_dispatch_claim.py. No request was made to a live control plane.
verificationResults.productionDispatcherEvidenceDetail: Workflow 338320444 (FactoryOS Render Worker & Queue Dispatcher): 588 runs, the most recent 100 all 'success', newest a schedule run on main at ed966487. Workflow 330390996 (FactoryOS Basic Cloud Rendering Pipeline): total_count 0 since it was created on 2026-08-09 — it has never run. A dispatcher that reports success every minute while the workflow it is supposed to dispatch has never executed cannot distinguish an empty queue from a failing claim, which is precisely the defect this PR removes. Scheduled runs execute from the default branch, so production behaviour does not change until this branch is merged.

ciResults.failureDetail: Floor 07 Pre-Training Validation failed at step 8, 'Run F07 invariant and receipt suites'. PRE-EXISTING and unrelated. Locally reproduced: the same four invariants (#5 separation of upload safety, monetization readiness and advertiser suitability; #6 non-YPP channel never blocks ordinary upload; #7 never claim YouTube will monetize; #12 G12 shorts eligibility boundary) fail with 39 passed on both this head and a pristine main worktree, and those tests call the F07 Guardian in-process from files this PR does not modify. Repository history agrees: of the last 300 F07 runs (2026-10-09 to 2026-10-17) 95 failed across 94 distinct head commits on unrelated branches. The workflow ran only because this change touches .okf/** and Team/reports/**, both in its pull_request path filter.
ciResults.cancelledDetail: Lightning Physical MP4 Render Proof was cancelled by its own fixed concurrency group (cancel-in-progress: true) when a later commit was pushed to this branch. Cancelled means not evaluated, not passed, and it is not a failure. That run produced no physical MP4 and none is claimed.

The dispatcher hardening and the worker-daemon syntax repair are complete and verified at unit, static and syntax level on final head 3ad2705a: all 52 rendering-engine tests collect with 0 collection errors, against a pristine main where the suite cannot run at all and 7 of those tests are uncollectable; the 18 new workflow invariant checks pass; typecheck and the authority registry pass; and the factoryos suite's failing-test count is identical on head and main (71), with the passing delta exactly the 18 added checks.
